title: Echoes Character Voice Direction and Line Casting Profiles

protected_categories.rationale: Combat readability and unit damage telegraphs are inviolable
Player command feedback clicks and tactical alerts must never be obscured

characters.canonical_persona: Pragmatic, field-hardened engineer-commander. She views operations through logistics constraints, fuel consumption, and structural survival rather than imperial doctrine. Unsentimental, direct, and protective of personnel under her command.

vocal_direction.pitch_description: Medium-pitched female alto with firm chest resonance
vocal_direction.cadence: Clipped, concise, operational. Emphasizes nouns and technical coordinates. Pauses between directives are brief and functional.
vocal_direction.emotional_register: Controlled urgency; never hysterical or panicked even under direct fire

characters.role: Memory-Bearer of the Third Kharuun Assembly
characters.canonical_persona: Living archive of Kharuun oral history and geological memory. Speaks with the weight of generations who survived the shattering in the deep faults. Deliberate, immovable, treating terrain not as an obstacle but as a physical record.

vocal_direction.pitch_description: Deep, resonant baritone with rich sub-bass undertones
vocal_direction.cadence: Measured, slow, deliberate. Distinct rhythmic spacing between phrases as if carving words into stone.
vocal_direction.emotional_register: Stoic reverence and formidable resolve. Never raises voice in anger; quiet intensity carries authority.

characters.canonical_persona: The unyielding bureaucratic spine of Meridian governance. Believes that order, survival, and justice are synonymous with maintaining an accurate ledger. Speaks without malice or warmth, reciting causal consequences with mathematical detachment.

vocal_direction.pitch_description: Even, low-mid tenor with crisp dental enunciation
vocal_direction.cadence: Metronomic, precise, unhurried. Articulates numbers and catalog designations with exact phonetic clarity.
vocal_direction.emotional_register: Impartial analytical calm. Even when reading total casualty reports, emotion is suppressed behind protocol.

characters.role: Supreme Chancellor of the Meridian Compact Core
characters.canonical_persona: The aristocratic architect of Meridian central authority. Eloquent, deeply educated in statecraft, and genuinely convinced that only rigorous centralized resource allocation prevents total planetary extinction. Charismatic and formidable.

vocal_direction.pitch_description: Smooth, cultured baritone with expansive vocal range
vocal_direction.cadence: Rhetorical, flowing, oratorical. Uses natural dramatic pauses and crescendos suited for public address.
vocal_direction.emotional_register: Supreme civic confidence and paternal authority. Never sounds petty or defensive.

characters.canonical_persona: A singular consciousness composed of thousands of overlapping survivor echoes entangled in the Broken Sun's solar radiation. Speaks not with multiple distinct voices, but as a singular voice with harmonic reverberation and non-linear temporal phrasing.

vocal_direction.pitch_description: Ethereal, dual-register voice with crystalline harmonics
vocal_direction.cadence: Fluid, cyclical, wave-like. Phrases rise and fall in pitch like tidal surges. Occasionally overlaps contradictory temporal statements.
vocal_direction.emotional_register: Transcendent melancholy mixed with fierce protective resonance. Speaks of past and future simultaneously.
